answer: Start with Proof of unique Fiverr order history. The idea is simple: orders delivered and rated by buyers across two years, and that bridge alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since orders delivered and rated by buyers across two years takes calendar time as well as money — and the reef is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The grove is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
